## What this changes

A short summary, and the issue it fixes (if any): Fixes #

## Type of change

- [ ] Guide / docs fix
- [ ] Example fix (`examples/`)
- [ ] Memory estimator change (`tools/vram_estimate.py`)
- [ ] New measured figure (memory or speed)

## How it was checked

- [ ] `python -m pytest -q tests` passes
- [ ] Commands in the changed docs were run as written
- [ ] New figures say what they were measured on (GPU, runtime + version, quant, context)

This repo can't change the model's behaviour; for a wrong answer, please open a "Model got something wrong" issue.
